recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes FHIR-13003 for the current model; broader discharge diagnosis, comorbidity, pre/post-op diagnosis, and THO value-set repair work should continue under FHIR-50827 or related PA/THO tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-13003 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue asking for Condition documentation on how to model diagnosis type after removing the DG1-6 Diagnosis Type mapping from Condition.clinicalStatus, with examples of admission diagnosis and primary diagnosis rank.
initial_application: Commit 8da21fd1e4 removed DG1-6 from the then-authoritative Condition.clinicalStatus v2 mapping, and commit bd3f8a7ba5 added the original FHIR-13003 Condition note pointing to Encounter.diagnosis.role and Encounter.diagnosis.rank. Later source refactors preserved the note, and FHIR-19285 reconciliation updated the stale role/rank links to current Encounter.diagnosis.use and Account.diagnosis.sequence.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 later redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis so admitting diagnosis is represented as an Encounter.reason value with an Encounter.reason.use code, diagnoses addressed during an encounter use Encounter.diagnosis, and billing rank belongs on Account. FHIR-19285 moved ranked billing diagnosis data to Account, FHIR-23764 confirms DG1-6 maps to Encounter.diagnosis.use, and FHIR-50827 is a later Triaged issue for broader unresolved diagnosis-role/value-set work.
reconciliation: Updated source/condition/condition-notes.xml to add current-model guidance that an admitting diagnosis that is the reason for an encounter uses Encounter.reason.value with Encounter.reason.use. The existing guidance for Encounter.diagnosis.use and Account.diagnosis.sequence was retained.
source_changes: source/condition/condition-notes.xml: added a sentence directing admitting diagnosis as an encounter reason to Encounter.reason.value with Encounter.reason.use.

related_jiras.note: Predecessor tracker removed DG1-6 Diagnosis Type from the Condition.clinicalStatus v2 mapping, creating the need for the FHIR-13003 follow-up note.
Redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis, including the current Encounter.reason.use path for admitting diagnosis and Account guidance for billing rank.
Moved ranked billing diagnoses from Encounter to Account and already corrected stale Condition note links from Encounter.diagnosis.role/rank to current targets.
Confirmed the current HL7 v2 DG1-6 Diagnosis Type mapping on Encounter.diagnosis.use.
Encounter diagnosis-use cardinality and terminology issue already audited on the combined branch and partly superseded by later Encounter changes.
Later Triaged issue records broader unresolved diagnosis-role/value-set repair work, outside this seed's final decision scope.
